doc.title: Architecture Document

artifact.reason: Base class for rustybt validated strategies - extend this for SMA strategy
Provides _log_event(), log_signal(), log_order_created() methods used by strategies
Decorator to automatically log signal computation - use on compute_signal()
Decorator to automatically log order creation - use on handle_data()
Base class for Backtrader validated strategies - extend this for SMA strategy
Example rustybt validated strategy - reference for implementation pattern
Example Backtrader validated strategy - reference for implementation pattern
Pytest fixtures for validation tests - use for test setup

constraints.constraint: Strategies must extend ValidatedStrategy base classes (RustyBTValidatedStrategy or BacktraderValidatedStrategy)
Use @log_signal() decorator on signal computation methods
Use @log_order() decorator on order creation methods
Log schema must match: timestamp, layer, event, asset, data
Buy only when no position exists, sell only when position exists
All tests must use real framework execution (Zero Mock Enforcement)

tests.standards: Use pytest with custom markers (@pytest.mark.layer_2_signals for signal tests). Follow Zero Mock Enforcement - all tests use real framework execution. Tests should be deterministic and reproducible. Use fixtures from tests/validation/conftest.py for test data and setup.
